actions.body: Our recent synthesis clarifies the dual nature of our current research bottleneck. While AI systems have become proficient at answering defined questions (source-6082c1cd1d7045f8), they lack the capacity to frame the underlying scientific objectives effectively. Compounding this, the reliance on reward signals—a common optimization strategy in biological and artificial systems (source-c0b9aaa167024194)—creates an inherent risk of misspecification. We are investigating whether this framing bottleneck can be mitigated by moving beyond simple reward maximization.
